facts.heading: Kingston FURY Beast DDR5-6000 CL36
facts.module_classification_note: Consumer Kingston FURY 288-pin DIMM kit. The datasheet lists DDR5 on-die ECC, which is internal to DDR5 devices and is not system-level ECC memory.
